title: 书页之间
intent: 陪伴睡前阅读，让细微变化像翻页后的短暂停顿，始终不牵走注意力。

tempo.feel: 松弛的四拍律动，轻微摇摆，鼓点低调

tonality.mode: 大调，以柔和的七和弦、加九和弦为主

instrumentation.name: 电钢琴
instrumentation.role: 以疏朗和弦维持温暖、稳定的背景

instrumentation.name: 尼龙弦吉他
instrumentation.role: 奏出简短的原创旋律，偶尔改变句尾

instrumentation.name: 电贝斯
instrumentation.role: 用稀疏的音符连接和弦与鼓点

instrumentation.name: 鼓机
instrumentation.role: 以轻柔底鼓、边击和细弱踩镲维持慢拍

structure.direction: 电钢琴先铺开和弦，吉他轻声引入两三音动机；鼓与贝斯缓缓进入。
维持稳定的轻柔律动；吉他动机留出长空隙，与电钢琴错开出现。
吉他只改变少量句尾音，电钢琴偶尔换一种和弦排列；短暂收起踩镲，形成阅读间隙般的停顿，不增加强度。
熟悉的动机轻轻返回，鼓和贝斯逐渐退去，以电钢琴和吉他的安静余音结束。

production: 约180秒。亲近、克制的声场，乐器层次清晰且整体音量平稳；保留电钢琴与鼓机的本来音色，以及尼龙弦吉他的自然音色。干净的录音质感，顺滑的瞬态和受控的峰值。
avoid: 突然的高潮或紧张转折
削波、噼啪杂音或数字失真
assumptions: 采用72 BPM的器乐嘻哈慢拍。
以电钢琴和尼龙弦吉他承载原创素材。
以应用设置的约180秒为时长目标。
lyriaPrompt: A roughly three-minute instrumental hip-hop piece for quiet bedtime reading: calm, comfortable, and unobtrusive from beginning to end. At 72 BPM in 4/4, use a gently laid-back beat with a soft kick, muted side-stick and faint closed hi-hat; no forceful backbeat. Warm electric piano plays spacious F-major seventh and add-nine chords, a rounded electric bass moves sparingly beneath them, and a softly picked nylon-string guitar carries an original, restrained two- or three-note motif. [Intro] Establish the chords and motif before the beat settles in. [Main Groove] Let the motif recur with generous space between phrases. [Subtle Variation] Change only a few phrase endings and chord voicings; briefly thin the hi-hat like a pause between pages, without building intensity. [Outro] Return to the familiar motif as drums and bass recede, ending quietly. Keep the dynamics even and the sound intimate. Clean studio recording, natural acoustic guitar timbre, faithful electric-piano and drum-machine tones, smooth transients and controlled peaks. No clipping, crackling or digital distortion. Original musical material; instrumental only, no vocals or vocal samples.
